home.title: Cadence — Start with what’s on your mind
home.description: Begin with a question, an unfinished idea or work already underway. Explore how Cadence can help independent artists see context and choose a next step.
home.headline:
Start with what’s
on your mind.
home.intro: A question, an unfinished idea, a burst of excitement, or work already underway. Begin with what’s real for you. Cadence helps you see the wider picture and choose what feels useful next.

sections.label: A PLACE TO BEGIN
sections.title: There is no one right starting point.
sections.body: You might arrive with a doubt, an instinct, a small win, a question or something you cannot quite name yet. You do not need a finished plan to begin.

sections.label: WAYS TO BEGIN
sections.title: Talk it through, or start with what you know.
sections.body: Cadence is shaped to understand, clarify, offer a possible next step and leave room for you to review. You can begin in conversation or go directly to work already underway.

cards.title: Put it into your own words.
cards.body: The Voice Doorway is an exploratory demo for talking through an intention and reviewing what takes shape.

cards.title: Start with work in motion.
cards.body: The product design moves from Map to Line to Detail to Task, keeping the wider context in reach.

cards.title: Leave room for a possibility.
cards.body: Exploration is a direction for ideas still forming. Its inclusion in the beta is not yet confirmed.

sections.label: A CLOSER LOOK
sections.title: From the wider view to one useful next step.
sections.body: Follow one fictional artist’s work from the whole picture to a specific Task.

sections.label: WHAT CLARITY CAN OFFER
sections.title: A clearer view, at your pace.
sections.body: Understand what is in front of you, choose where to focus and keep the connected work in view.

cards.title: See how work connects.
cards.body: Bring different pursuits into the same wider view without making them all the same kind of work.

cards.title: Choose a focus.
cards.body: Move from Map to Line to Detail to Task, then return to the wider context when you want it.

cards.title: Respond with context.
cards.body: See what a change may affect. Decisions about connected commitments remain yours.

sections.label: WHY CADENCE
sections.title: Support for the career you choose.
sections.body: Cadence is being shaped to meet your work where it is and help you move toward what matters to you—with context, room to explore and the final choice in your hands.

sections.label: EARLY ACCESS
sections.title: Bring what matters to you.
sections.body: Whether you have a question, an idea in progress or a direction you want to explore, you can review the approach and request beta access when it feels right.

faqs: Do I need to have a clear plan before I start?
No. Cadence is being shaped to meet you with a question, an unfinished idea, work already underway or a direction you want to explore. You choose where to begin.
What is the Voice Doorway?

It is an exploratory interactive demo that shows a conversation becoming a reviewable plan. It uses fictional starting data; microphone and session availability are required. See the Demo page for details.
What can I see now?

The site includes a manually controlled walkthrough of approved desktop design states and a link to the separate Voice Doorway demo. Sample work is fictional; neither demo operates your Cadence account.
Can I request beta access here?
Yes. Share your email and a short note about what you want to make real. A request expresses interest; it does not guarantee a place or commit you to payment.
What will the beta cost?
Beta pricing is being finalized. The Pricing page explains what is known and what is still open.

features.title: Features — Find a way forward with Cadence
features.description: Explore how Cadence meets artists through conversation or existing work, then moves from Map to Line to Detail to Task.
features.headline:
Begin where you are.
Move toward what matters.
features.intro: Start with a conversation or with a pursuit already underway. Cadence is designed to help you understand the context, find a useful focus and choose how to continue.

sections.label: BEGIN WHERE YOU ARE
sections.title: Bring a conversation or existing work.
sections.body: The Voice Doorway is an exploratory way to talk through an intention. If you already know the work, begin with a pursuit and choose where to focus.

cards.title: Talk it through.
cards.body: Explore an intention in the Voice Doorway, then review and correct the plan it proposes.

cards.title: Start with what you know.
cards.body: Begin from a pursuit already underway and move through the work at your pace.

sections.label: 01 / MAP
sections.title: See the pursuits in your wider view.
sections.body: Map brings different pursuits into one view. A release, a live show and a collaboration can sit in the same bigger picture while each remains its own kind of work.
sections.aside: A Pursuit is something you are working to make real.

sections.label: 02 / LINE
sections.title: Follow one pursuit at your own pace.
sections.body: Open a pursuit to see its Line. Movements group meaningful parts of that pursuit and help you decide where to focus.
sections.aside: A Movement groups a meaningful part of a Pursuit.

sections.label: 03 / DETAIL
sections.title: See the work inside a Movement.
sections.body: Detail brings the Tasks within a Movement into view. Look at their context before choosing what to do.
sections.aside: Context stays available as you move closer.

sections.label: 04 / TASK
sections.title: Bring one Task into focus.
sections.body: A Task is a specific piece of work within a Movement. Focus on it, then return to the Line or Map whenever you want more context.

sections.label: WHEN THINGS CHANGE
sections.title: See what changes. Choose what follows.
sections.body: When something moves, understand the possible effect on connected work. Cadence does not automatically change every connected commitment; the choices remain yours.

sections.label: EXPLORATION
sections.title: An idea can stay open while it takes shape.
sections.body: Exploration is a place in the product direction for ideas before you decide what, if anything, to commit. Its inclusion in the beta is still being confirmed.

faqs: Is the walkthrough a live account?
No. The product visuals come from approved design states and use fictional work. They illustrate the intended structure, not every capability that will be in the beta.
Does Cadence make decisions for me?
The product direction keeps commitment choices with the artist. A change in one pursuit should not silently rewrite every connected commitment.
Can I start with an idea that is still forming?
Yes. The Voice Doorway is an exploratory demo for talking through an intention. The Map walkthrough shows how existing pursuits are organized.
Can a team use Cadence?
The initial audience is independent artists. Team access, roles and collaboration arrangements are not confirmed.

pricing.title: Pricing & beta access — Cadence
pricing.description: See what is known about the Cadence beta invitation, participation and pricing. Beta pricing is being finalized; requesting access does not collect payment.
pricing.headline:
Know what you’re
being invited into.
pricing.intro: You deserve clear details before deciding whether to join. Here is what we know, what is still being finalized and what we will explain before asking for a commitment.

sections.label: THE BETA
sections.title: Beta pricing is being finalized.
sections.body: Included capabilities and access arrangements are also being confirmed. We will explain the offer before asking anyone to join.

cards.title: Express interest.
cards.body: A request expresses interest. It does not create an account, guarantee a place or commit you to payment.

cards.title: Review the details.
cards.body: You will be able to review price, included capabilities and participation details before deciding.

sections.label: THE EXPERIENCE
sections.title: A beta shaped around your work.
sections.body: The experience is still being defined. We will confirm its included capabilities, support and participation details before access opens.

cards.title: See your wider view.
cards.body: The intended product brings the pursuits you choose to carry into context.

cards.title: Move toward a focus.
cards.body: The design follows Map → Line → Detail → Task.

cards.title: Continue at your pace.
cards.body: The product direction keeps room to step back, explore and choose what comes next.

sections.label: TAKING PART
sections.title: Clear expectations come first.
sections.body: Before access opens, we will explain how feedback works, what support is available and what may change. Requesting access does not sign you up for research or create a participation commitment.

sections.label: AFTER THE BETA
sections.title: Future terms will be clear.
sections.body: Post-beta plans, pricing and transition terms are not confirmed. We will make them clear before asking you to make a future commitment.

faqs: Is beta access free?
No price or free-access offer is confirmed here. Beta pricing is being finalized.
Do I need a payment card?
This request does not collect payment details. Any requirements for the beta will be explained before access opens.
Does requesting access guarantee a place?
No. The request preview does not establish selection, timing or capacity. Those arrangements are still being finalized.
Will I be charged after the beta?
There is no confirmed billing arrangement or post-beta price. Future terms must be explained before any payment commitment.

about.title: About & vision — Cadence
about.description: The belief behind Cadence: meet independent artists where they are, offer useful context and leave room for their choices.
about.headline:
Meet the work
where it is.
about.intro: A music career includes finished plans, half-formed ideas, work underway and everything that happens alongside it. A useful tool should make room for all of it.

sections.label: THE OBSERVATION
sections.title: Artists begin in different places.
sections.body: One person may arrive with a question, another with a burst of motivation or a pursuit already in motion. Curiosity, uncertainty and clarity can all be part of the same creative life.

sections.label: OUR PRINCIPLES
sections.title: Support that leaves the choices yours.
sections.body: Cadence should offer context and possible ways forward while leaving room to explore, correct the picture and decide what happens next.

cards.title: Hold the wider view.
cards.body: See how different pursuits relate without flattening them into the same kind of work.

cards.title: Focus when you choose.
cards.body: Move close to one part of the work, then step back whenever you need perspective.

cards.title: Leave commitments with you.
cards.body: Make connected choices visible. Keep the decision with the artist.

sections.label: BEHIND THE WORK
sections.title: A practice of listening first.
sections.body: Cadence is being developed by Rob Martin. The product direction starts with a simple question: how can software offer useful structure while respecting an artist’s attention and agency?

sections.label: THE LONGER VIEW
sections.title: More context. More room to choose.
sections.body: The longer-term vision is a connected instrument that can meet artists across the changing shape of their work. This is a future direction, not a capability claim about the beta.

sections.label: BUILD WITH US
sections.title: Help shape what this can become.
sections.body: Cadence is being built for independent artists. Explore the current design and request beta access if the direction feels useful to you.
